name: yandex-metrika-mcp
description: Read-only Yandex Metrika (Яндекс Метрика) reports, period comparisons, time series and exports with explicit data quality.
long_description: Sign in with Yandex in the browser (no token in the chat), pick counters and ask your AI client about traffic, sources, landing pages and goals. Every answer states dates, time zone, sampling and filters. Read-only: nothing in Yandex Metrika can be changed.

tools.name: metrika_status
tools.description: Connections, export jobs and the next step.

tools.name: metrika_connect
tools.description: Sign in with Yandex in the browser (read-only access).

tools.name: metrika_disconnect
tools.description: Remove a connection and its token from this computer.

tools.name: metrika_describe_counter
tools.description: Counter time zone and goals with IDs.

tools.name: metrika_catalog
tools.description: Presets, metrics, dimensions and period presets.

tools.name: metrika_run_report
tools.description: One-period report with totals, quality and provenance.

tools.name: metrika_run_timeseries
tools.description: Day, week or month dynamics with exact buckets.

tools.name: metrika_export_report
tools.description: Background CSV/JSON export of all rows.

tools.name: metrika_read_artifact
tools.description: Read a finished export file in chunks.
